preview.text: Sydney Sixers Women and Brisbane Heat Women meet in a T20 match at Hurstville Oval, where they have played 16 recorded T20 matches against each other, with Sydney Sixers Women winning 6 and Brisbane Heat Women winning 10. Brisbane Heat Women won the toss and chose to bowl first. In the 18 recorded T20 matches at Hurstville Oval, the usual first-innings score is 134.

summary.text: Sydney Sixers Women won by 46 runs. SYSW made 136-3, Elsa Hunter top-scoring with 43 off 43 balls; Lily Bassingthwaighte took 1 for 20. BRHW made 87-8, Charli Knott top-scoring with 24 off 18 balls; Courtney Sippel took 3 for 13. Sides batting first at Hurstville Oval usually make about 134.
